title: Double free in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a… (CVE-2026-85890)
description: A double free vulnerability in the Chromium-based Microsoft Edge browser allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code remotely over a network. This flaw can lead to complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8 but no known exploits in the wild have been reported as of the publication date.
